decision_rationale: The abstract and full text describe VCWorld as a perturbation-response predictor using an LLM reasoning engine, but the selected method section reformulates it as a gene-centric classification task with a text-based inference function. That supports biological data plus text, but only as an LLM-backed wrapper rather than a generative text-bio foundation model.
evidence_snippet: "knowledge graph-to-text pipeline for prompt generation"; "reformulate the problem as a gene-centric classification task"; "f : L(c,p,g,BioContext) → Prediction"; "text-based inference function"
